Section B
Answer any three questions.
Each question is introduced by stimulus material. In your answer you may refer to this material and/or
to other examples that you have studied.

parts.text: Identify two ways of measuring unemployment.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain two factors that could influence living standards, apart from unemployment rates.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Analyse how market forces can increase wages.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Discuss whether or not free trade between countries increases economic growth.

text: Unemployment in the United Kingdom (UK) fell in December 2021 to 4.1%. Market forces would
usually mean that wages would increase due to this lower unemployment. However, workers’
living standards did not increase. New international trade deals were not made fast enough to
offset the decreasing trade between the UK and the European Union.

Discuss whether or not improving education can help a government achieve its macroeconomic
aims.

text: Approximately 95% of students in Macao, a special administrative region of China, attend a
private school. Internationally, competition for students is high amongst private schools. Private
schools are often technologically innovative in their methods of teaching. However, some argue
that private schools make the government aim of redistribution of income more difficult to achieve.
